title: rl.CloseAudioDevice() deleted with no seam replacement — audio device never closed on normal builds
detail: The PP_SW_AUDIO seam wraps every other lifecycle call but defines no audio_close_device; the close was simply deleted, so non-SW builds leak the device at teardown while the comment still promises it.
recommended_fix: Add audio_close_device to both seam branches (no-op under PP_SW_AUDIO, rl.CloseAudioDevice otherwise) and restore the call in audio_destroy.

title: Gallery/font-check candidate swap replaces only the body font — header and NOC surfaces render the shipped family for every candidate
detail: Title, toasts, crisis banner (font_header) and NOC rows (font_mono) draw shipped Plex regardless of candidate, contradicting the PR body's per-family comparison on those surfaces.
recommended_fix: Swap all three fonts in gallery_arm and font_check (load the candidate's header/mono variants), so per-candidate captures actually reflect the candidate.

title: Claimed gallery retry budget is a dead field — polls can spin forever
detail: retries is never read or written and GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES is never defined; every condition poll (pipe, sel_pipe, overlay, panel) retries wait=5 unbounded — a hung capture runs forever.
recommended_fix: Increment gallery.retries per poll miss and bail out (log + exit) at a GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES constant, resetting on success — or remove the field.

title: font_check.odin comments contradict the pipeline this same diff ships
evidence:
+	// draw_row copies the string's raw UTF-8 BYTES (the game's draw_text_c
+	// truncates every rune to a byte — ASCII-only canon; the specimen's ⚠
+	// rows need the real UTF-8 encoding to reach the atlas).
+	// load_hud_font — a failed load is FATAL, never a silent fallback-font
+	for b in transmute([]u8)(txt) {
+		append(&cbuf, b)
+	}
detail: The comment claims draw_text_c truncates runes, but this diff rewrites it to copy raw UTF-8; another comment cites deleted load_hud_font, whose recipe was the silent default fallback.
recommended_fix: Update both comments: the shipped helper copies raw UTF-8 bytes; the loader recipe is fail-loud load_font_file.

title: noc_row ladder comment still documents the pre-overhaul sizes
detail: The contract comment says 14px body / 10px labels while this diff draws 15px body rows and 12px section labels — the claimed comment fixes missed this one.
recommended_fix: Update the ladder comment to the shipped sizes (15 body, 12-13 labels).

title: Missing fallback font asset passes load_fonts silently — outside the fail-loud contract
detail: A deleted or unreadable noto_sans_symbols2 asset yields ok=true — app and harness run without the ⚠ glyph, silently; only the CI negative-control pin would notice.
recommended_fix: Treat an unreadable committed fallback as failure (return nil, 0), or guard FONT_FALLBACK_ASSET existence in load_fonts.

title: Font tests discard caller-owned atlas and glyph arrays despite the documented ownership contract
evidence:
+	_, _, ok := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_ASSET)
+	testing.expect(t, ok, "the committed HUD family must load")
+// The caller owns the atlas image (upload + UnloadImage, or just UnloadImage).
detail: The guard test drops the returned atlas, recs and MemAlloc'd merged glyph arrays on success; font_probe_warning frees nothing either — the render suite leaks per call.
recommended_fix: UnloadImage the atlas and free glyphs/recs (or UnloadFont the data-stage font) in the tests and the probe.

title: audio_flush replacements misindented (extra leading tab)
evidence:
for k in 0..<a.pending.crisis_plays {
 		v := (a.pending.crisis_variant + i32(k)) % CRISIS_VARIANTS
-		rl.PlaySound(a.crisis[v])
+			audio_play_sound(a.crisis[v])
detail: All four audio_play_sound replacement lines in audio_flush carry an extra tab versus the two-tab lines they replace — misindented inside otherwise uniform loops.
recommended_fix: Re-indent the four lines to match the surrounding block.

title: Identical when/else EndDrawing branches — no-op conditional with misleading comment
detail: Both branches are byte-identical, so the conditional does nothing; the adjacent comment says 'Release builds carry nothing' while the else branch carries EndDrawing.
recommended_fix: Collapse to a single rl.EndDrawing() call and keep only the post-flush ordering comment.

title: Upgrade preview keeps raw pixel sizes while every sibling panel was converted to hud() scaling
evidence:
-	draw_text_c(v, "UPGRADE PREVIEW", x, y, 16, p.ink)
+	draw_header_c(v, "UPGRADE PREVIEW", x, y, 17, p.ink) // 2026-08-23: panel header -> SemiBold + bigger
-		draw_text_c(v, "WEATHER REPORT", x, y, hud(v, 16), p.ink)
+		draw_header_c(v, "WEATHER REPORT", x, y, hud(v, 17), p.ink) // 2026-08-22: panel header -> SemiBold; 08-23: bigger-text ruling
detail: Forecast/health/settings/QoS headers ride hud(v, …) but the upgrade preview passes raw 17/15 — the a11y text-scale knob still won't scale this panel.
recommended_fix: Wrap the upgrade-preview sizes in hud(v, …) so the panel joins the same ladder and scale.
